title: Maximum Sum of Two Non-Overlapping Subarrays
summary: Given an integer array, find the maximum sum of two non-overlapping subarrays of specified lengths.
statement: Given an integer array, find the maximum sum of two non-overlapping subarrays of specified lengths. The first subarray can precede or follow the second, but must not overlap.
constraints: Values are nonnegative and the requested lengths fit without overlap.
hints: Prefix sums make each fixed-length window sum constant-time.
For each ordering, scan the later window while retaining the best earlier window.
Compute both first-before-second and second-before-first, then take the maximum.
Every nonoverlapping pair has exactly one of these two orders and is considered at its later endpoint.
editorial: Every nonoverlapping pair has exactly one of these two orders and is considered at its later endpoint.
